meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行分类、预测、异常检测等机器学习任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理时间序列数据并需要专用算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform classification, forecasting, anomaly detection on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with temporal data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你做时间序列的机器学习任务，比如分类、预测、聚类、找异常、分割、找相似模式等。它会用 aeon 工具包来分析和建模时间数据。
howto.when: 当你需要处理带时间标签的数据（如股票价格、传感器读数），并想用专门的算法做分类、预测或异常检测时，Claude 会使用这个技能。

say.text: 用 STOMP 检测这段时间序列中的异常点。
say.note: Claude 会计算异常分数并标记异常。

say.text: 用 TimeSeriesKMeans 把这几条时间序列聚成3类。
say.note: Claude 会执行聚类并返回聚类标签和中心。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform time series machine learning tasks such as classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search using the aeon toolkit.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when you work with temporal data (e.g., stock prices, sensor readings) and need specialized algorithms for classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, etc.

say_en.text: Classify the GunPoint dataset using RocketClassifier.
say_en.note: Claude loads data, trains the classifier, and outputs accuracy.

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this time series using STOMP.
say_en.note: Claude computes anomaly scores and marks outliers.

say_en.text: Cluster these time series into 3 groups with TimeSeriesKMeans.
say_en.note: Claude performs clustering and returns labels and centers.
